hypothesis: One baseline can be the wrong one. Add the two models that live in the same repo and ask whether ANY baseline in this field beats us in ANY cell at 100,000 exposures.
changed_variable: the baseline architecture; train ids, exposures, seed, evaluation ids, grid, evaluation function and background-rule selection all held fixed
success_criterion: our CLEVR-trained core beats the best baseline PER CELL on all three metrics on all three datasets
outcome: met at seed 0: 9 of 9 cells against a best-per-cell composite of three different models; narrowest margin Tetrominoes foreground_iou +0.0345, flagged as unsettled

data.split_manifest_version: fixed320 reserved evaluation, not an independent original-paper TEST split
data.protocol: patch contract: truth quantised to the grid, predictions reduced to the grid by patch majority vote, never expanded to pixels
data.train_ids: the identical 10,000 drawn by np.random.RandomState(2553500).choice(Dataset.train, 10000, replace=False) that the 253 core trained on
data.truth_tensor: Dataset.labels(ids, split) at grid 64, np.repeat-ed x2 to 128 inside the npz -- the same tensor our evaluation function uses

baselines.name: ItrSA
deviations: batchsize 256 -> 128: 256 OOMs on one 23.47 GiB TITAN RTX (20.73 GiB already in use); the published recipe is multi-GPU and train_obj.py:224 divides the batch by the process count. The exposure budget is epochs x 10,000 and does not depend on batch size.
baselines.budget_note: far below its published numbers; the 1/210 caveat applies

baselines.name: AKOrN (conv)
deviations: batchsize 256 -> 128, same 128 as ItrSA so the two rows are mutually comparable
baselines.budget_note: ALREADY AT its published CLEVR number (60.5 vs 59.0+-4.3) and near its Tetrominoes one (72.1 vs 76.4+-0.8). For this model the budget is not the binding constraint, so the 'give it its full budget' objection does not cover our Tetrominoes margin over it.

ours_for_comparison.readout: core alone, no head -- regions_253 out of the cache, scored by evaluate_patch_masks
ours_for_comparison.scorer_validated: score_cache.py reproduces the published reference rows exactly: CLEVR 0.8421/0.7545/0.6410 and Tetrominoes 0.8580/0.7885/0.8173

own_metric_agreement_fg_ari: ours vs each model's own eval_obj.py: <=0.0013 on every cell

corrections_to_earlier_records: PV2_0150 README and commands.sh said 'Batch 250 x 40 batches x 10 epochs = 100,000 exposures exactly'. The argument default is 256, not 250, with a partial final batch, and PairDataset feeds two views per sample. The exposure count (10 passes over 10,000 unique images) is right; the arithmetic as written was not. No PV2_0150 number changes.
limitations: seed 0 everywhere; the contract judges 3-seed means

no seed spread at all for ItrSA or AKOrN (conv)
